title: Add configurable op_type for index watcher action

timeline.message: add configurable op_type for index watcher action
timeline.author: Dan Hermann

timeline.body:
This allows the index action to work with data streams which require an `op_type` of `create`.

Fixes #64535
maybe validate that only create or index op type can be used?

reply.body: Thanks, @martijnvg. What versions do you think we should target for this?

timeline.body:
Maybe also document that if the `index` action should be used with a data stream that the optype must be set to create?
LGTM

timeline.message: limit to index and create op_types
timeline.author: Dan Hermann
Dan Hermann
Dan Hermann
